title: CBC-1890-T-TS Grounds Maintenance
description:
Central Bedfordshire Council has awarded a contract for the provision of grounds maintenance services across Council-managed sites.
The contract covers planned and reactive grounds maintenance activities, including grass cutting, hedge and shrub maintenance, vegetation management, ground-level tree works, litter and debris clearance, maintenance of hard surfaces and associated grounds maintenance services.
